title: The Choir That Sang Behind the Beat
central_conflict: every singer at the concert followed the conductor a beat too late
decisive_choice: the new wireless rehearsal monitors were delaying what singers heard
resolution: switched to a direct monitor feed and rehearsed the opening together
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered every singer at the concert followed the conductor a beat too late before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they asked everyone to sing faster but the voices fell further apart; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized the new wireless rehearsal monitors were delaying what singers heard; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they switched to a direct monitor feed and rehearsed the opening together, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Auction With Two Winners
central_conflict: two neighbors both believed they had won the same charity auction
decisive_choice: a numbered paddle looked like six from one side and nine from the other
resolution: replaced the ambiguous paddle and repeated the bidding fairly

title: The Bubble Parade Without Bubbles
central_conflict: the parade's giant bubble wands made only cloudy drops
decisive_choice: minerals in the well water were reacting with the bubble solution
resolution: mixed a small test batch with soft water and restored the bubbles
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the parade's giant bubble wands made only cloudy drops before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they poured in more soap but the mixture produced even less foam; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized minerals in the well water were reacting with the bubble solution; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they mixed a small test batch with soft water and restored the bubbles, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
